spans.text: Night falls over the beach as the voting finally comes to an end.
WA2000 takes the MVP slot through the number of Proofs of Goodness accumulated.
Everyone watches as Gr G36 accepts the MVP plaque from the Commander.
Congratulations, Gr G36. Your performance tonight was truly worthy of being MVP.
Thank you for your trust in me, Master.
Gr G36 smiles and holds up the plaque that belongs to her and the Villagers.
The Commander sighs in relief, as though a great weight has been lifted. Being able to read the situation, they wisely back off and yield the stage to the rejoicing Dolls.
That's our Gr G36 for you! You're amazing!
K-PDW would have totally fooled us if it wasn't for Gr G36's keen observations! Gr G36 deserves to be MVP!
My, my Knight's curse has been broken at last! Bweeehhh... Thank you, Miss Gr G36!
The Villagers collectively gaze at Gr G36 with looks of delight.
Hmph. I've never seen such a simple and crude way of determining victory before!
Eh, forget it. Besides, I'm sure we'll get something good out of the Head Maid's victory!
I saw her making lots of yummy food in the kitchen just now!
Mmmmm... Donuts, cake, fruit juice, ice cream... I like all of them!
Gr G36 clears her throat and calmly steps forward.
Friends and colleagues, the game is over and all disagreements are behind us.
In order to celebrate the end of the event, I've prepared a surprise for everyone—

I now declare that tonight, everyone from the Villager faction will be able to enjoy the "Dessert Feast" I made for free by presenting your role card. This offer is only valid for tonight and only for Villagers.
Really? Woohoo!!!
An even louder round of cheers erupts from the Villagers.
What about the Werewolves? Don't we get anything?
Unfortunately, this is a token of appreciation to reward my fellow teammates for their hard work, and also a little punishment for you in my role as Cupid.
What?! Didn't you say the game was over?! And now you're discriminating against us as Werewolves by not giving us anything to eat?!
This is unfair!
Unfair, you say?
Gr G36 tilts her head, looking both innocent and stern at the same time.
But if I recall correctly... I was the first person who was "killed"...
And the reason for doing so was food-related, was it not?
Gr G36 smiles faintly, but there is a cunning glint in her eyes.
Now then, since there are no further questions, let's enjoy the spread tonight! Have fun, everyone~
The Villagers make faces at the Werewolves in a blatant display of schadenfreude, before carrying Gr G36 off in a round of celebratory body tossing...
The Werewolves exchange looks before frowning in frustration.
A new battle plan begins brewing in their hearts...
Near the Hunter's Roundup stall.
I expected nothing less of Miss Gr G36's ice cream, it's so rich and fragrant and melts in the mouth...
Hm? DP-12, aren't you going to help yourself to the desserts Miss Gr G36 made?
After seeing DP-12's empty hands, 4 Shiki asks an innocent question.
(Sigh) I lost my role card on my way to the kitchen...
Could I borrow yours for a bit, 4 Shiki? I'm a Villager too, and it would be a shame if I couldn't enjoy the desserts with the others...
Hmm... I'd really like to help you, but...
Miss Gr G36 took my Villager role card away while verifying my identity just now, so...
I see... I'll go search again, then.
Near the Devil's Pond stall.
Didn't I tell you to bring three boxes of desserts back? Why do you only have one?
UKM-2000 stands in front of Five-Seven and Type 95 with her head lowered, holding tightly to the box of snacks in her arms.
There, there, UKM, there's no need to be scared... Did you run into any difficulty in the kitchen?
We might be able to help you if you tell us about it...
I... I just... because...
Hm?
UKM-2000 takes a deep breath—
I didn't expect you to be a Werewolf too, Type 95!!!
Miss Gr G36 told me about everyone's true identities just now! I still can't believe it!!!
So I'm not going to help you get anything tonight! I, I... I'm voting for the Villagers! They're honest, they don't scheme and they don't lie!
UKM-2000's face goes red as she runs off at top speed. Five-Seven and Type 95 frown as they watch her leave...
Near the Witch's Hut.
I grated some mint and sprinkled it on the cake... See, isn't it tastier now?
Wow, you can actually do that? You're amazing, Miss Springfield!
Hehe... Here, I'll feed you a bite. Careful, don't spill it—
Just as Springfield reaches out and brings her spoon to Gr G28's mouth...
Omnomnomnom—
A petite form rushes out of the darkness, her gaping maw open wide...
And with the cake just a millimeter away from her mouth—
Uwaaaah— What's this?! Some kind of cake-stealing seagull?!
Gr G28 reflexively swings at her—
And with a splash, the poor AA-12 is cast into the waves...
At the Fiery Beacon stall, a pair of shifty-looking figures sneak in while there's nobody around...
Dammit, I can't find a single one... They took all their role cards with them! Not a single forgetful one among them!
Uuurgh... sugar... I need sugar...
And Mss Gr G36's ice cream, and Miss Springfield's cake...
Delirious from pain, AA-12 curls up on the ground and starts shovelling sand into her mouth...
Oi! Pull yourself together!!!
By the seaside, at the Werewolves' temporary camp.
Five-Seven sighs heavily as she paces back and forth with her thoughts in a mess.
Our "stalking wolves" were all exposed and we couldn't get a single role card!
What should we do? Are we doomed to spend the night suffering?!
Everyone looks at AA-12, who is completely drenched and utterly pitiful. They can see their own suffering reflected in her.
Hang on... I just got an idea.
There's one person in the world whose requests Miss Gr G36 can't refuse...
The Commander!!!
The others all exclaim at once before Type 95 can finish.
You're right! Everything will be solved if Honey intercedes for us!!!
I should have thought of that earlier!!!
The light of hope is rekindled in the eyes of the Werewolves.
They exchange looks and immediately concoct the plan for their final stratagem...
10 minutes later, at Kalina's voting booth.
The ragged Werewolves silently file in front of the Commander, the corners of their eyes glinting with what look like tears...
...I have a rough idea of what's going on...
Commander, while we don't mind not having desserts, AA-12 might end up in a terrible state without sufficient sugar, the poor girl...
That's right. AA-12 almost drowned just now because she was delirious from a lack of sugar...
As the leader of the Werewolves, I can't bear to watch this any further, so I had to beg you for help!
We need you to convince Miss Gr G36... Help us, Commander, you're our only hope!
Team Werewolf looks expectantly at the Commander's face.
(Sigh) Alright then. If it's just a few snacks, then leave it to me! I'm sure Gr G36 will listen to reason!
As the Commander leaves, the Werewolves smile in relief.
At the seaside, by the temporary kitchen.
After listening to the Commander's impassioned plea, Gr G36 folds her arms in silence. However, the impatient Gr G28 steps forward—
Commander, you ought to know how the Werewolves treated Miss Gr G36 during the game, right?!
Leaving aside the fact that AA-12 was the one who first brought up killing off Gr G36, she even used the Werewolves' intel to blackmail us into making ice cream for her...
Is it wrong to make them pay for that now that Miss Gr G36 won? Besides, it's just not having a dessert or two, it's not some cruel and unusual punishment—
Uwaaaah! Honey, do you even hear her? That's not what a decent human being would say, is it?!
Everyone's enjoying yummy stuff while we're stuck staring at them, how is that even fair?
Don't you know how cruel it is?!
Five-Seven gently puts a hand on K-PDW's shoulder to calm her down and turns to the Commander.
She makes the most pitiful puppy-dog eyes she can manage—
Erm. Look, Gr G36, I think they've suffered enough.
Just look at AA-12, she's totally drenched. After not getting sweets and thinking about what she did to you, she was overcome with guilt and almost ended it all by jumping into the sea...
If we hadn't found her in time, we might only have met her again in a repair tank!
Seeing as how AA-12 is so sincere about apologizing, can't you find it in yourself to reconsider...
What clumsy acting...
Alright then, since you're asking on their behalf...
Gr G36 sighs in resignation and slowly sweeps her gaze over the Commander and the Werewolves.
Actually, I wasn't going to let you all go hungry.
Miss Gr G36 is truly magnanimous.
It's just a game, after all... And after going through all that, you've been punished enough.
Please enjoy these glasses of cool drinks.
Gr G36 serves up several glasses of freshly-made snowcap milk tea. The translucent liquid shimmers beautifully in the light.
I can't accept this! You're too kind, Miss Gr G36...
Wow!!! Since you're being so generous, then don't mind if I do—
Sweets— My sweets...
However, I have a condition.
Gr G36 smiles and continues in a quiet voice.
While the Werewolves may partake of tonight's refreshments...
There is one thing I would like to ask of you—
The Werewolves freeze. They suddenly have the sense that something very bad is going to happen.
I would like the No. 1 culprit behind killing me—AA-12, and the No. 2 culprit—K-PDW to do something for me...
Please do all the dishes in the kitchen.
Once you're done, you can claim your refreshments.
Haaaaah?!
What?! Honey~
K-PDW and AA-12 shoot pleading looks at the Commander. However, Gr G36's smile is resolute and even more meaningful now.
Ahem. Well, since Gr G36 is tonight's MVP, I don't feel comfortable contradicting her any further...
Anyway, you're in her hands now! Make sure you work hard and repent of your sins!
Two wails of despair fill the air, adding a strange undertone to the lively celebration.
Five-Seven sighs quietly, then raises her fruit tea while silently exchanging looks with her two surviving teammates.
As I thought, the one person we can't offend is the head chef... I've learned that now...
Hehe... I can cook too, Miss Five-Seven. Make sure you're nicer to me in future~
Well, the storm's passed, at least... Let's raise our glasses and enjoy the night.
The sound of glasses clinking fills the night. The three of them smile and nod to Gr G36...
Three hours later, in the temporary kitchen.
At last... They're all done...
The intensive labor has sapped AA-12 and K-PDW of all their strength. The two of them collapse by the sink, too tired even to cry.
Thank you for your hard work. These are for you. I hope you enjoy them.
Gr G36 smiles kindly to them and sets the drinks down on a nearby table.
Ohhh... fruit tea... sweet fruit tea...
Whew... I sure worked hard!
Glugluglug...
The sound of eager drinking comes from the kitchen tent as the sound of Gr G36's footsteps fades into the distance.
Hm?! Wait a minute! This explosive bite, this cool, sour aroma...
Ugeeeeh—!
This is horrible! Help meeee!!!
Why... why is this sour and bitter and even a bit spicy? Why isn't it the least bit sweet?!
(Coughs and gags) Surely this isn't Gr G36's standard of drinks, is it?!
K-PDW and AA-12's faces go green as snot pours down their faces and they collapse to the ground in wailing heaps...
On the other side of the beach.
So, um... About the drinks I sent off to the kitchen... How did they taste?!
I had people try them out. The result was surprisingly good.
Thank you for your hard work, Miss WA2000.
Really?! Alright! I did it at last!
Gr G36 smiles as well. It seems she's been infected by WA2000's excitement.
Oh yes, what a perfect night...
Lycan Sanctuary [END]
